nativeHint: Puts all 17 pointers and the pointer size back to the Windows defaults
copyHint:
Cursor copies are saved
Original files can be moved
subtitle: Import .ani, PNG or GIF, remove backgrounds and tune the hotspot to make your own cursor
pathPlaceholder: Paste the full path of an .ani, .cur, image or folder
dropHint: Drop an .ani, .cur, PNG, GIF or several images here
animationHint: .ani and GIF keep their animation; number several images 1, 2, 3… first, or reorder them on the timeline
pointingHint: Pointing is the link-hover cursor, not a mouse-button-down state
hotspotHint:
Drag on the preview image or enter X / Y
Coordinates start at the top-left corner
enlargedHint:
Enlarged to make the hotspot easier to place
Switch to actual size to see it as Windows will
zoomHint: Switch between enlarged and actual size
previewHint:
Preview at 1:1 (Windows pointer size)
Display scaling may change the actual size
markerHint: The hotspot cross is hidden after applying
errorDetail: Check the file or settings and try again; details follow
deleteMessage: This removes the theme without changing current system cursors
ready: Only configured modes are applied; other cursors stay unchanged
imported: Imported with animation and hotspot preserved
applied: Applied to the Windows pointer settings
restored: Last change undone; no earlier undo is available
applyFailed: Operation incomplete; check the error details
loadFailed: Loading failed; existing settings are preserved
refreshWarning: Applied, but Windows did not reload the pointers right away
previewFailed: Some previews could not load; reimport the affected file
invalidLibrary: Invalid library format; original data is preserved
chooseANI: Choose an .ani or .cur file, or images such as PNG, JPG or GIF
chooseHint: Choose one .ani or .cur, or several images / a folder (sorted 1, 2, 3… by name into an animation)
frameIntervalHint: How long each frame shows when building an animation from images
aboutDescription:
The animated cursor studio for Windows
Import .ani, PNG or GIF, remove backgrounds in one click, tune the hotspot, and make the cursor truly yours
backgroundHint:
Auto remove clears the background colour touching the edges
With the magic wand on, click a colour in the enlarged preview to remove it
wandActiveHint:
Click a background colour on the preview; connected similar colours are removed
Click enclosed areas separately, then press Magic wand again when done
backgroundRemoved: Background removed; frame order, timing and hotspot kept
nothingRemoved: Nothing to remove here; try another spot or raise the tolerance
originalRestored: Restored the image from before background removal
updateNoRelease: There is no release on GitHub yet; the project page shows the latest progress
timelineHint:
Sorted by file name 1, 2, 3… (numbering your images in order first helps)
Drag thumbnails or use ◀ ▶ to reorder, ✕ to remove a frame
inUseHint: This theme is currently applied to the system
sizeHint: Shared by every pointer, the same as Settings › Accessibility › Mouse pointer. Takes effect when you release the slider
sizeChanged: Windows pointer size set to {0} px
waitHint: Busy is also used for Windows’ "Working in Background" pointer unless you set that one under More pointers
calibrateTip: Click a few dots to work out where the hotspot should be
calibrateHint: Inside the area below, the pointer becomes this cursor. Put the tip you see on the centre of the dot, then click.
calibrateTooFar: That was too far from the dot. Try again.
calibrateAccurate: Off by less than 1 — the hotspot is already accurate
calibrateDone: Hotspot updated. Apply the theme to use it.
styleHint.pixel: Drawn on a coarse grid, so the square pixels show
styleHint.jagged: Smooth inside, but hard stepped edges like classic pointers
